name: Desolate
subtitle: from whence you came
rules: COST – Pick a number for X, where X is less than or equal to the number of [O] you control. -- EFFECT – Destroy all characters with X strength.
notes: Catalog uses EXTRA COST templating; card prints COST.

name: Foment
subtitle: quite the showman
rules: COST – Pick a resource you control. (You can pick face-down resources.) -- EFFECT – Put the resource into your hand. Draw a card. -- FLIP UP – 1 [O][O] and play a resource.
flavor: "I have a reputation to live up to. If my show does not make people vomit, and have an erection at the same time, then I've let my audience down."
notes: Card prints 'Put the resource into your hand'; catalog says 'into its owner's hand' (differs for a resource you control but do not own).

name: Hextilda, the Exiled Crone
subtitle: i've been wanting one with a beard
rules: UNIQUE HEXTILDA -- TOIL AND TROUBLE -- COST – Pay 4. Deplete this card. Pick a card you control with at least 1 token on it. -- EFFECT – Double the number of tokens on the card.
flavor: ...I like to be tickled...just a bit...just a bit...

name: Hideous Hexapede of Horror
subtitle: original Open R&D concept by kallisti
rules: HIDEOUSLY HORRENDOUS HEX OF HELLISHLY HORRIFYING HATRED -- COST – Pay 6. Destroy this card. Pick 6 characters. -- EFFECT – Inflict 6 damage to each of the characters. Inflict 6 damage to all factions. Both players remove 6 cards in their hand from the game. Both players remove 6 cards in their discard pile from the game. Both players remove the top 6 cards of their deck from the game.
flavor: You don't want to know what the sixth effect is.
notes: Card prints 'Both players'; catalog says 'All players' (same in a two-player game).

name: Imperial Thaumaturge
subtitle: what's that over there?
rules: TICKLE -- COST – Pay 1. Deplete this card. -- EFFECT – Your opponent discards a card.
notes: Card prints 'Your opponent discards a card'; catalog says 'An opponent'. Footer also has a line of runic glyphs between artist and copyright (decorative, not transcribed).

name: Inadequate Wand
subtitle: you want it to be one way. but it's the other way.
rules: PRESENT THE STAFF -- COST – Pay 2. Deplete this card. Pick a character you control. -- EFFECT – Put the character into its owner's hand if you can. If you do, X is its numeric cost. You may search your deck for a tactic with numeric cost X or less and reveal it. If you do, put it into your hand.
notes: 'other' is italic in the subtitle.

name: Manifest
subtitle: we are the weavers of shadowy phantasms
rules: COST – Reveal a face-down tactic you control. -- EFFECT – You may play the tactic. Draw a card. -- While this card is in your discard pile, if a card that provides at least [O] enters play under your control, you may pay 2. If you do, put this card into play under your control as a face-down resource. -- FLIP UP – 1 [O]
notes: Catalog uses deploy/EXTRA COST templating and 'when a card that provides' where the card prints 'if a card that provides' (same trigger).

name: Meat of the Mountain
subtitle: with herb stuffed radicchio
rules: If a player draws any number of cards, that player may add or remove a token from this card. If they do, generate the effect which corresponds to the new number of tokens on this card: -- 0 TOKENS – That player's opponent discards a card. -- 1 TOKEN – That player may look at the top 2 cards of their deck. If they do, they put 1 into their hand and 1 on the bottom of their deck. -- 2 TOKENS – That player may pick a character or location. If they do, put it into its owner's hand. -- AT LEAST 3 TOKENS – That player may play a resource.
notes: Card: 'If a player draws' / 'That player's opponent discards a card'; catalog: 'When a player draws' / 'That player's choses an opponent to discard a card' (catalog typos 'choses', 'owners's'). Same in a two-player game.

name: Minion of Thabbash
subtitle: salad isn't the only thing you'll be tossing
rules: COVERT -- PROVIDES – [O]
flavor: A dead dog in a gnarled old tree. Decapitated orphan. Spiral staircase, evil queen, scarecrows, spiders, pumpkins, clowns.

name: Muddle
subtitle: original Open R&D concept by flowing_deep_suns & koikaze
rules: COST – Play this only in response to a tactic being played. Pay X, where X is its numeric cost. -- EFFECT – Duplicate the tactic. Terminate the tactic.
notes: Catalog uses deploy/EXTRA COST templating; card prints play/COST.

name: Nattering Stoopswaggler
subtitle: that's not water
rules: COVERT -- If you played this card using FLIP UP, it enters play with a token on it. -- While there is a token on this card, it loses COVERT and gains 1 strength and 1 life. -- If there are no tokens on this card and it's destroyed, flip it face-down under its owner's control instead. -- FLIP UP – 3 [O][O]
notes: Card prints 'and it's destroyed'; catalog 'and it would be destroyed'. Catalog uses deployed for played.

name: Obscene Astrologer
subtitle: your "moons" are in apex
rules: GAZE UPON THE "STARS" -- COST – Deplete this card. -- EFFECT – You may play a tactic with numeric cost X or less for free, where X is either 5 or the number of [O] you control, whichever is lower.
flavor: "When are women going to learn? Every plural noun means boobs."
notes: Ability name prints with quotes around STARS; catalog omits them; catalog uses deploy for play. Footer also has a line of runic glyphs (decorative, not transcribed).

name: Otter Floss
subtitle: not to be confused with "flossing the otter"
rules: Draw a card. Put a card from your hand on the bottom of your deck. Put this card into play under its owner's control as a face-down resource instead of into their discard pile.

name: Perturb
subtitle: that's starting to get annoying
rules: Look at your opponent's hand and pick a non-resource card in it. Your opponent discards that card. You may pick a card of the same type as the discarded card. If you do, put it into its owner's hand.
notes: Card says 'your opponent'; catalog says 'an opponent' / 'that player'.

name: Redonkulous
subtitle: it's better than turning into a rooster, or a guy named Richard.
rules: COST – Pick a character. -- EFFECT – If you played this card using FLIP UP, your opponent discards 2 cards. If your opponent has 3 or fewer cards in their hand, remove the character from the game. -- FLIP UP – 5 [O][O]
notes: Card: 'your opponent' discards 2 cards / has 3 or fewer cards in hand. Catalog: 'that character's controller' does both, which changes who discards when the picked character is yours.

name: Ritual of the Double Monkey
subtitle: monkey see...monkey do...
rules: Your opponent discards a card. If you control [O][O][O], your opponent discards another card. If you control [O][O][O][O][O][O][O][O], your opponent discards another card. -- FLIP UP – 2 [O]
notes: Card says 'your opponent'; catalog says 'an opponent' / 'that player'.

name: Titillated Mooncalf
rules: If a card that provides at least [O] enters play under your control, you may pick a character. If you do, it gains COVERT this turn.
notes: The line under the name is printed in runic glyphs (not transcribed), so subtitle is null. Card prints 'If a card that provides'; catalog 'When a card that provides' (same trigger).

name: Tumescent Guilt Bladder
subtitle: repository of self deprecation
rules: At the end of your turn, put a token on this card. Your faction loses X influence, where X is the number of tokens on this card. You may play a resource. -- At the start of each turn, if there are at least 3 tokens on this card, your opponent takes control of it. Remove all tokens from this card.
notes: Card says 'your opponent takes control'; catalog says 'an opponent'.

name: Verrucose Brains
subtitle: now with cream filling!
rules: At the end of each turn, put the character with the lowest numeric cost into its owner's hand. If there is a tie, you decide which character is affected.

name: Witty Worm
subtitle: original Open R&D game mechanic by kallisti
rules: While this card is in your hand you may reveal this card as you are playing a resource. If you do, you may play this card for 1. -- When this card enters play, you may put a resource you control into its owner's hand. If you do, you may play a resource.
notes: Catalog uses deploy where the card prints play.

name: Woadenworm Gloamspike, Thabbashite Prince
rules: UNIQUE GLOAMSPIKE -- All your face-down tactics gain FLIP UP with numeric cost and threshold equal to their regular numeric cost and threshold.
flavor: "I don't make threats...I just tell it like it is."
notes: Two-line name, no subtitle.

name: Alluring Quicksand
subtitle: like taking a baby from its candy
rules: COST – Pick a character. -- EFFECT – Flip the character face-down under its owner's control. -- RECUR – [G][G][G][G] -- COST – Use this only if this card is in your discard pile. Pay 2. Remove this card from the game. Pick a character. -- EFFECT – Flip the character face-down under its owner's control.
notes: Catalog uses EXTRA COST templating; card prints COST.

name: Ceremonious Groomer
subtitle: "what was his name again?... Jean-Luc!"
rules: If this card is destroyed, flip it face-down under its owner's control instead.
notes: Card prints 'is destroyed'; catalog 'would be destroyed'. The flavor slot is filled with runic glyph text (not transcribed), so flavor is null.

name: Clam Hash
subtitle: mmm...claaam haaash...
rules: COST – Pick a character. -- EFFECT – This turn, the character gains 2 life. If you played this card using FLIP UP, put this card into its owner's hand instead of their discard pile. -- FLIP UP – 2 [G][G]
notes: Catalog uses EXTRA COST and deployed templating.

name: Delectable Boon
subtitle: original Open R&D concept by Iskariot & kallisti
rules: COST – Choose a number for X. Pay X. Pick 2 characters, locations, and/or factions. -- EFFECT – The next X damage inflicted to the first picked card this turn is inflicted to the second picked card instead.
notes: Catalog uses EXTRA COST templating; card prints COST.

name: Derelict Seafarer
subtitle: it's hardly an ideal world
rules: When this card enters play, your faction loses 3 influence. Put a random card from your discard pile into your hand. -- RETIRE – [G][G][G] -- COST – Use this only while this card is not in a battle. Pay 2. -- EFFECT – Flip this card face-down under its owner's control. -- FLIP UP – 3 [G]
flavor: In an ideal world, I'd have all 10 fingers on my right hand so my left hand would just be a fist for punching.

name: Dowsing Cleric
subtitle: let's see...50 paces north...then 20 paces east...
rules: When this card enters or leaves play, you may search your deck for a staple resource, reveal it, and put it into your hand.
flavor: "If you can think of a better way to find water, I'd looove to hear it."

name: Dwarvish Grimalkin
rules: [G][G] – When this card enters play, draw a card. -- [G][G][G][G][G] – When this card enters play, draw a card. -- [G][G][G][G][G][G][G][G][G] – When this card enters play, draw a card. -- FLIP UP – 2 [G]
notes: The line under the name is printed in runic glyphs (not transcribed), so subtitle is null.

name: Emissary of Loot
subtitle: it's your money. you paid for it.
rules: If a card that provides at least [G] enters play under your control, you may put a token on this card. -- DELIVER -- COST – Pay 1. Remove a token from this card. Pick a character. -- EFFECT – This turn, the character gains 2 life. -- SHORTCUT -- COST – Pay 1. Remove a token from this card. -- EFFECT – This turn, this card gains COVERT.
notes: Card prints 'If a card that provides'; catalog 'When a card that provides' (same trigger).

name: Framptle Tromwibbler, Lord of Bling
subtitle: original Open R&D concept by Lioge
rules: UNIQUE FRAMPTLE -- Characters cannot attack or be restored. -- At the start of your turn, put a token on this card. -- If this card has at least 2 tokens on it, destroy it.
flavor: "I've made some empty promises in my life, but hands down... this was the most generous."
notes: Card prints 'If this card has at least 2 tokens on it, destroy it'; catalog 'When this card has at least 2 tokens on it' (same state trigger).

name: Gilded Yurt
subtitle: original Open R&D concept by ishinken
rules: CHILLAX -- COST – Deplete this card. Pick a character you control. -- EFFECT – Remove the character from the game. At the start of your next turn, if this card is in play, put the removed character into play under your control.
notes: Card prints 'Remove the character from the game' / 'the removed character'; catalog uses current 'void' wording (voided character). Per CARD-MARKUP-PROGRESS this is updated templating.

name: Grandiose Resurrector
subtitle: come forth! lest yon nip go without cat.
rules: RECUR – [G][G] -- COST – Use this only while this card is in your discard pile. Pay 5. Remove this card from the game. Pick up to 4 characters in your discard pile. -- EFFECT – Put the characters into your hand.

name: Gus VanBaymaven
subtitle: "...and my scratchpostarium will go there..."
rules: UNIQUE GUS -- ALL YOUR BAYS ARE BELONG TO GUS -- COST – Pay 2. Deplete this card. Pick a location. -- EFFECT – Take control of the location. -- FLIP UP – 2 [G][G][G]
artist: Brandon Chng 'Kaizo' of Imaginary Friends Studios
notes: Footer also has a line of runic glyphs between artist and copyright (decorative, not transcribed).

name: Hidden Ruins
subtitle: covered by the desert sands
rules: COST – Reveal a face-down location you control. -- EFFECT – You may play the location. Draw a card. -- While this card is in your discard pile, if a card that provides at least [G] enters play under your control, you may pay 2. If you do, put this card into play under your control as a face-down resource. -- FLIP UP – 1 [G]
notes: Catalog uses EXTRA COST/deploy templating and 'when a card that provides' where the card prints 'if' (same trigger).

name: Lodge Dock Florist
subtitle: "hoe-cake, murder."
rules: UNIQUE LODGE DOCK FLORIST -- All characters gain the rules text "At the start of your turn, you may pay 1. If you don't, destroy this card."
flavor: Mural: Yonder nor sorghum stenches shut ladle gulls stopper torque wet strainers.
artist: Jennyson Rosero and Buddy Jiang of Imaginary Friends Studios

name: Melty Cheese
subtitle: sooo...tasty...
rules: ATTACH TO CHARACTER -- The attached character gains 2 life and cannot attack. -- FLIP UP – 2 [G] and your faction gains 4 influence.
notes: Badges print +0 STR, +0 SPD, +2 LIFE.

name: Miraculous Regeneration
subtitle: i can haz braaaiiinnnz!?
rules: COST – Pick 2 characters in your discard pile. -- EFFECT – Put 1 of the characters into play under your control as a face-down resource. Put the other character into your hand.
notes: Catalog uses EXTRA COST templating; card prints COST.
